WITH snapshot AS (
  SELECT json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.metadata.mktcombo') AS market_pair,
         (json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.quotes.askquote')
          - json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.quotes.bidquote'))
          / json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.quotes.midquote') * 100 AS spread_percentage,
         json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.momentum.mktfeel')  AS market_sentiment,
         json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.momentum.buyforce') AS buy_force
  FROM marketdata m
  JOIN analyticsindicators a ON a.mdataref = m.marketdatanode
)
SELECT market_pair,
       spread_percentage,
       market_sentiment,
       buy_force,
       AVG(spread_percentage) OVER (PARTITION BY market_sentiment) AS avg_spread_percentage_for_sentiment,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY spread_percentage) AS spread_percentile_rank
FROM snapshot

SELECT json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.oscillators.rsi14spot') AS rsi14spot,
       json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.oscillators.macdtrail') AS macdtrail,
       json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.oscillators.bbandspan') AS bbandspan,
       json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.momentum.techmeter')    AS techmeter,
       (ABS(json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.oscillators.rsi14spot') - 50)
        + ABS(json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.oscillators.macdtrail'))
        + json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.oscillators.bbandspan') * 0.01) / 3
       * CASE json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.momentum.techmeter')
           WHEN 'Buy' THEN 1 WHEN 'Sell' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS technical_signal_strength
FROM analyticsindicators a

WITH latest_exec AS (
  SELECT e.ordersmark, e.remaincount
  FROM orderexecutions e
  WHERE e.orderexecmark = (SELECT MAX(e2.orderexecmark)
                           FROM orderexecutions e2
                           WHERE e2.ordersmark = e.ordersmark)
)
SELECT o.recordvault AS order_id,
       o.dealcount   AS order_quantity,
       l.remaincount AS remaining_quantity,
       (o.dealcount - l.remaincount) / o.dealcount * 100 AS order_fill_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN latest_exec l ON l.ordersmark = o.recordvault

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.metadata.mktcombo')              AS market_pair,
    json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.quotes.midquote')                AS mid_price,
    json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.flow.smartforce')         AS smartforce,
    json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.flow.retailflow')         AS retailflow,
    json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.flow.instflow')           AS instflow,
    json_extract(a.market_sentiment_indicators,'$.big_players.whalemotion') AS whale_activity,
    s.priceshiftday                                                         AS price_change_24h,
    json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.quotes.midquote') * (1 + s.priceshiftday) AS next_price_4h
  FROM analyticsindicators a
  JOIN marketdata  m ON m.marketdatanode  = a.mdataref
  JOIN marketstats s ON s.marketstatsmark = a.mstatsref
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN smartforce > retailflow * 1.2 AND smartforce > instflow   * 1.2 THEN 'Smart Money Dominant'
    WHEN retailflow > smartforce * 1.2 AND retailflow > instflow   * 1.2 THEN 'Retail Dominant'
    WHEN instflow   > smartforce * 1.2 AND instflow   > retailflow * 1.2 THEN 'Institutional Dominant'
    ELSE 'Mixed'
  END                                         AS flow_dominance,
  whale_activity,
  market_pair,
  NULL                                        AS avg_price_change_1h,
  NULL                                        AS avg_price_change_4h,
  AVG(price_change_24h)                       AS avg_price_change_24h,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (smartforce > retailflow AND smartforce > instflow AND next_price_4h > mid_price)
             OR (smartforce < retailflow AND smartforce < instflow AND next_price_4h < mid_price)
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS smart_money_accuracy
FROM base
GROUP BY flow_dominance, whale_activity, market_pair
ORDER BY smart_money_accuracy DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN realline > 0 THEN realline ELSE 0 END) AS total_positive_realline,
       SUM(CASE WHEN realline < 0 THEN realline ELSE 0 END) AS total_negative_realline,
       SUM(CASE WHEN realline > 0 THEN realline ELSE 0 END)
         / ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN realline < 0 THEN realline ELSE 0 END)) AS profit_factor
FROM accountbalances

SELECT r.riskandmarginpivot,
       o.recordvault AS order_id,
       ab.accountbalancesnode,
       json_extract(r.risk_margin_profile,'$.margin_thresholds.inithold') AS inithold,
       ab.margsum,
       json_extract(r.risk_margin_profile,'$.margin_thresholds.inithold') / ab.margsum * 100 AS margin_utilization
FROM riskandmargin r
JOIN orders o           ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
JOIN accountbalances ab ON ab.usertag    = o.userlink

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT m.quote_depth_snapshot AS snap
  FROM marketstats s
  JOIN marketdata m ON m.marketdatanode = s.mdlink
  WHERE s.marketstatsmark = (SELECT MAX(marketstatsmark) FROM marketstats)
)
SELECT o.recordvault AS order_id,
       o.dealedge    AS trade_side,
       o.dealcount   AS order_quantity,
       CASE WHEN o.dealedge = 'Buy'
            THEN json_extract(ls.snap,'$.depth.askdepth')
            ELSE json_extract(ls.snap,'$.depth.biddepth') END AS order_book_depth
FROM orders o
CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
WHERE o.dealcount > 0.1 * (CASE WHEN o.dealedge = 'Buy'
                                THEN json_extract(ls.snap,'$.depth.askunits')
                                ELSE json_extract(ls.snap,'$.depth.bidunits') END)

SELECT json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.metadata.exchnote')  AS exchange_code,
       json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.metadata.timetrack') AS snapshot_timestamp,
       (json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.quotes.askquote')
        - json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.quotes.bidquote'))
        / json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.quotes.midquote') * 100 AS spread_percentage
FROM marketdata m
ORDER BY json_extract(m.quote_depth_snapshot,'$.metadata.timetrack') DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT r.riskandmarginpivot,
       json_extract(r.risk_margin_profile,'$.position.possum')  AS possum,
       json_extract(r.risk_margin_profile,'$.position.posmagn') AS posmagn,
       ab.walletsum,
       CAST(json_extract(r.risk_margin_profile,'$.position.posmagn') AS REAL)
         * json_extract(r.risk_margin_profile,'$.position.possum') / ab.walletsum AS effective_leverage
FROM riskandmargin r
JOIN orders o           ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
JOIN accountbalances ab ON ab.usertag    = o.userlink

WITH latest_vol AS (
  SELECT volmeter FROM marketstats
  WHERE marketstatsmark = (SELECT MAX(marketstatsmark) FROM marketstats)
)
SELECT r.riskandmarginpivot,
       json_extract(r.risk_margin_profile,'$.position.possum') AS possum,
       v.volmeter,
       json_extract(r.risk_margin_profile,'$.position.possum') * v.volmeter * 0.01 AS pvar
FROM riskandmargin r
CROSS JOIN latest_vol v
ORDER BY json_extract(r.risk_margin_profile,'$.position.possum') DESC
LIMIT 5
